<a id="scale_chars"></a>
### [`scale_chars`](../../../../src/status/scale_chars.asm#L6) `$922B-$9233`

*data*

The characters of a scale cell, from empty to full: $20 (space), $2a, $29, $28, $26, $25, $24, $23 and $22 (full). A step up writes scale_chars,x after a match at scale_chars-1,x. A step down writes scale_chars-2,x.

- **Read by:** [`overload_step_up`](mower_overload.md#overload_step_up)
- **Referred to by:** [`mower_cooling`](mower_cooling.md#mower_cooling), [`overload_step_up`](mower_overload.md#overload_step_up), [`dog_loyalty_step_down`](../dog/dog_loyalty.md#dog_loyalty_step_down), [`dog_tolerance_step_down`](../dog/dog_tolerance.md#dog_tolerance_step_down)
